content: विनिपातः .²1 Falling down, a fall. .²2 A great fall, calamity, an evil, loss, ruin, destruction; विवेकभ्रष्टानां भवति विनिपातः शतमुखः <ls>Bh. 2. 10</ls> (where it has sense 1 also); विधिहेतुरहेतुरागसां विनिपातोऽपि समः समुन्नतेः <ls>Ki. 2. 34</ls>. .²3 Decay, death. .²4 Hell, perdition; <ls>Ś. 5</ls>. .²5 Occurrence, happening. .²6 Pain, distress; जपतां जुह्वतां चैव विनिपातो न विद्यते <ls>Ms. 4. 146</ls>. .²7 Disrespect.
